title: UPC Extraction
description: Structured evidence selected from a specific representation at an exact location. The central interoperability contract. A direct_quote is exact verbatim text, verified byte-for-byte against the representation at a char_range locator (the hop-B gate, §03); text is a faithful, possibly paraphrased statement that is never verified and never presented as a quotation. An extraction must never become an orphaned quotation.

extraction_id.description: ext-<12hex> (§06), content-addressed over source_id + representation_ref + JCS(locator) + (direct_quote else text).

representation_ref.description: The representation this extraction was taken from; the primary locator indexes into it.

status.description: Lifecycle state; defaults to active. Only active extractions are gated and exported.

text.description: Faithful statement of the evidence. MAY be paraphrased/normalized. NEVER verified; MUST NOT be presented as a quotation.

direct_quote.description: Exact verbatim span. If present, MUST equal the representation's codepoints at the char_range locator, byte-for-byte, with no normalization (hop-B gate).

context_before.description: Advisory only; the authoritative context is the representation read at the locator.

locator.description: Primary locator. A direct_quote requires a char_range locator into a textual representation.

secondary_locators.description: Additional coarse locators (page, section, heading, …) for human context. Advisory: never gate-bearing, excluded from identity.

query.description: The question/task/purpose that prompted this extraction.

rationale.description: Why this is relevant / how it supports the query.

resolves_to.description: For in_text_citation extractions: the bibliographic target the marker resolves to.

supersedes.description: ext-id this extraction replaces (e.g. after reanchoring to a new representation).

ext.description: Tool-private extension data, namespaced by tool (e.g. {"pi-forge": {...}}).
